build.note: Build executed externally per constraints. Binaries expected at build-vulkan/bin/Release/.

hardware_fixture.constraint: Current pair is not 4 discrete cards. AMD reported memory is shared host memory, not dedicated discrete VRAM. Exclude AMD integrated shared memory from purchased VRAM totals.

model_chooser.preflight_license: Must be locally hashed licensed GGUF. No downloads permitted.

small_correctness_model.purpose: One-card numerical baseline and mixed correctness proof
small_correctness_model.note: Deliberately small to fit single card usable budget. Exact hash/size/quant to be recorded in run manifest before execution.

capacity_test_model.purpose: Exceed largest single card usable dedicated memory; fit predicted sharded plan across available cards
capacity_test_model.min_size_bytes: Must exceed gpu_0 usable dedicated VRAM minus KV reserve
capacity_test_model.note: Unique weight/KV ownership on multiple cards required. Duplicated models/CPU offload do not satisfy single-model VRAM-capacity gate.

options.-o: comma separated list of exact op names (as given by ggml_op_desc()), full test case strings, and/or regexes matched against the op name
options.-b: run tests on the given backend (e.g. CPU, MTL0, CUDA0)
options.-p: filter test cases by a regex matched against their params
options.--test-file: read test operators from a test file generated by test-export-graph-ops
options.-j: run tests using <n> parallel worker threads (default: 1, test mode only)

flags.-dev/--device: comma-separated device names, or none (default: auto)
flags.--list-devices: Print the available devices and their memory
flags.-fa/--flash-attn: on | off | auto (default: auto). Required when using --split-mode tensor and/or quantized V cache.
flags.-fit/--fit: on | off (default: on). Auto-fit unset args to device memory. Not supported with tensor.
flags.-c/--ctx-size: Context size (referenced in troubleshooting for OOM mitigation)
flags.-np/--parallel: Concurrent sequences for llama-server (referenced in troubleshooting)

flags_operators_audit.operator_graph_extraction: Use test-backend-ops --test-file <path> where <path> is generated by test-export-graph-ops from the actual selected model. Do not guess operator lists.

numerical_method.reference: Independent CPU ggml reference via test-backend-ops default mode (compare with CPU backend for correctness).
numerical_method.tolerance: Fixed tensor/logit fixtures; tolerance, dtype and quantization recorded. Reference local executor achieved max absolute error 8.344650268554688e-06 at atol=rtol=5e-5.
numerical_method.rejection_criteria: Reject an unsupported operator, invalid output or repeated fallback that defeats the intended capacity test. Generated prose alone is weak correctness evidence.

instrumentation.memory_peak_method: Inspect logs and peak allocations. Record leased-but-unallocated bytes, resident bytes, high-water mark.
instrumentation.allocator_limitations: Ratio flags (--tensor-split) are coarse placement hints, not hard byte limits. Auto-fit disabled in tensor mode.
instrumentation.no_fake_stats: Do not invent per-layer resident statistics. Use only returned physical/backend or RPC device names and measured telemetry.
instrumentation.transport_recording: Record cross-device host-staging traffic. Actual transport record unknown if not instrumented. Directed peer access probed per pair; do not force P2P when runtime rejects it.

execution_bounds.supervision: Parent process must enforce bounded wall time and warmup repeat counts explicitly before launch. Existing harness uses 60-second child supervisor.
execution_bounds.cancellation_failure: Worker exit, OOM and cancellation lead to explicit failed/retryable state. No false PASS. A failed worker's KV cache may be lost; never claim transparent session recovery without checkpoints/replay.

baselines.one_card_small: Qualify small computation on single card first. Compare against CPU numerical reference.
baselines.mixed_same_workload: Repeat same layer-split experiment on mixed Vulkan. Compare against each single-card and same-vendor baseline at identical model/quantization/context/batch settings.

rpc_scope.excluded_configuration: Current shared AMD + tiny OpenCL + CPU four RPC workers do not qualify for GPU compute qualification.
rpc_scope.requirement: Workers must own tensor computation; four whole-model chat servers are a task pool. Select only RPC names so coordinator native aliases do not double-count cards.
